# Alec

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P12](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Alec is described as having lovely, curly, black hair. He is also noted for being good-tempered.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)_

## Personality

Alec is a good-tempered individual distinguished by his lovely, curly black hair. He possesses a practical understanding of attending to a lighthouse light, demonstrating competence equal to that of his relative.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)_

## Traits

- good-tempered  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)</sub>

## Abilities

- understands attending to the lighthouse light (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Alec married Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) at her insistence, taking the name [Alec Davis](../character/davis.md). During a visit to [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), he arrived to announce that John Douglas's mother was dying, an event that led to her passing shortly thereafter.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P41](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0041), [v3 ch.Lady P49](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0049), [v3 ch.Lady P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050), [v3 ch.Lady P51](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0051), [v3 ch.Lady P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 ch.Lady P55](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0055), +256 more_

## Relationships

### [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alec and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) are rival suitors competing for the affections of [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) back in her hometown. Their simultaneous courting of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) forms a shared point of competition between them, particularly when visitors like [Anne](../character/anne.md) come to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) and observe Phil's indecision regarding her admirers.

- Rival of — rival suitors for Phil Gordon  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Speaks P5](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0005)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

Alec acts as one of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's persistent suitors back in her hometown of [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). He actively courts her alongside his rival [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), contributing to Phil's indecisiveness and reluctance to grow up as she weighs her options among her local admirers.

- Romantically involved with — suitor  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), +1 more</sub>

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--uncle-jim.md)

Alec is the nephew of [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md). Their familial relationship connects them within their shared family structure.

- Relative of — nephew (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)</sub>
